caption: The drawing shows a textile or embroidery pattern featuring a variety of stylized botanical elements. The predominant features are large, five-petaled flowers colored in red and pink with yellow centers, surrounded by green leaves and stems. To the left, a wavy, scalloped border is outlined in red and green bands. Below the central flowers, there are clusters of small purple circles resembling grapes, also with green leaves attached. The background is filled with intricate, densely packed, swirling patterns in light gray or off-white, suggesting quilted or stitched texture. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller section of the same pattern, displaying part of the scalloped border, a red flower, and green foliage. The composition is tightly filled, with objects abutting or overlapping, and the colors used are primarily shades of red, green, purple, yellow, and neutral off-white or gray. The name "BYRON A. DINKINS" is printed in greenish text below the larger section.
